# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 13 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 13

**13:1** And when she was in her sixth month, Joseph came from his buildings, and he entered his house and found her with child. And he struck his face and threw himself on the ground upon sackcloth and wept bitterly, saying, "With what face shall I look toward the Lord God? What prayer shall I make concerning this maiden? For I received her out of the temple of the Lord God as a virgin, and I have not kept her. Who has set this trap for me? Who has done this evil in my house and defiled her? Has the story of Adam been repeated in me? For as Adam was away in the hour of his prayer, and the serpent came and found Eve alone and deceived her, so also has it happened to me."

**13:2** And Joseph arose from the sackcloth and called Mary and said, "Why have you done this? You have forgotten the Lord your God. Why have you humbled your soul, you who were brought up in the Holy of Holies and received food from the hand of an angel?"

**13:3** But she wept bitterly, saying, "I am pure, and I know not a man."

**13:4** And Joseph said to her, "Whence then is that which is in your womb?"

**13:5** And she said, "As the Lord my God lives, I do not know whence it came to me."
